methods.baseline: Starting composition backend with PNG sampling disabled; baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline bookends.
methods.timing: Complete-sequence warmup followed by three alternating paired legacy/composition render+readback passes; median ratio.
methods.preview: 60 evenly spaced authored frames per run, three alternating legacy/composition runs paced by RAF, eight RAF warmup frames, no readback. CSS 640x360. CPU call and RAF interval diagnostics; GPU completion is not guaranteed by these timings.
methods.pixel: 11 sampled frames compared against legacy in the same profile at near; three reverse seeks checked against SHA-256. Hardware near diagnostics do not establish pinned-export perceptual preview parity. Identical PSNR sentinel is 999.
methods.profile: 60 evenly spaced frames; exclusive/inclusive hooks with gl.finish after device calls. Queued GPU execution remains included in readRegion timings. Stage times are rounded to 0.001 ms; exact acceptance timings are retained. Detailed stages are retained for the first baseline and first candidate; later rounds retain the total.
methods.barrier: Matching legacy/resource preparation, complete-sequence warmup, then 60 sampled warmup frames. Three passes measuring render call, forced one-pixel framebuffer read (queue drain plus fixed synchronization overhead), and subsequent full readback. Not a pure shader timer.

png.retained: Conservative mip levels above zero only; current-input eligibility and damage skip.
png.rejected: Movement-history fallback changes seek bytes; unrestricted mip-zero sampling regresses static matte.

readback.reason: Mixed performance: bracket improves, matte regresses; typography ratios overlap baseline drift. Prototype only; no production buffer changes.
